verdicts.explanation: The Results section states that the nanopillar-array a-NaxTaO3 films (PO2 = 11 Pa, measured at RT in air) have σ = 5.2 × 10–8 S cm–1 at x = 0.01, which matches the record. The Abstract and Conclusion give 8.0 × 10–8 for x = 0.01, but the record correctly follows the Results value, and the null sintering, density and temperature-in-°C fields are consistent with the paper.

The Results section gives σ = 1.2 × 10–7 S cm–1 for x = 0.1 in the nanopillar-array films measured at RT in air. The PLD method, AC impedance method, experimental origin and null secondary fields are all consistent with the paper.

The Results section gives σ = 2.8 × 10–6 S cm–1 for x = 1 in the nanopillar-array films measured at RT in air, and the record matches this. The Abstract and Conclusion instead say 2.5 × 10–6, so the paper is internally inconsistent, but the record reports the value stated for this measurement, and the other fields are supported.
